item.tib: gyim shod gzhi gnas mchod pa'i thabs dgos 'dod rin chen char 'beb
item.coloph: gyim shod gzhi gnas mchod pa'i thabs/ dgos 'dod rin chen char 'beb 'di/ mu spungs snang snyen (brnyan) skyes mchog rje/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis/)rten 'brel brdas bskul ba'i ngor/ me ston nyi ri wer zhi yi (yis/)sgrub gnas gang de'i yang dben du/ sa stag zla ba'i tshes la sbyar/ gzugs med gzugs snang 'khrul gyur bshags/ bstan 'gro phan bde 'byung 'gyur cig/
